newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand signs countertrade deal with three firms.
newsitem.headline: Thailand signs countertrade deal with three firms.

text.p: Thailand has signed three countertrade deals for vehicles and military equipment with Intermarine SpA of Italy, Mercedes Benz AG and Matra Defence of France, the commerce ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry's foreign trade department said it signed the combined 1.09 billion baht (US$43.6 million) contracts this week with the three firms on behalf of the navy and army.

The department did not detail products being bought from the three firms but said the agreements called for Thailand to provide them a wide range of goods including toys, garments, leather shoes, plastic and ceramic products, canned pineapples and frozen shrimps and chickens.
The three firms were prohibited from re-selling the Thai products to related Thai markets, including chickens to Japan and toys to the United States and the European Union.
Thailand has concluded countertrade agreements worth 8.61 billion baht since 1994, 4.79 billion of which were signed this year.
The department said it would sign two similar deals with foreign firms in mid-September on behalf of the state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT).
